request.what: Treasury withdrawal to make Cardano the title sponsor of Rare Evo 2026 main stage and global livestream and to support Cardano Dev Gov Day 2026.

claims.claim: Rare Network requests ₳2,750,000, described as $660,000 at a $0.24 ADA valuation, to cover two Cardano sponsorship packages and related fees, taxes, and a 2027 venue deposit.

The budget allocates ₳1,166,666.67 to Cardano Dev Gov Day 2026, ₳833,333.33 to Rare Evo 2026 title sponsorship for main stage, livestream, and media, and ₳750,000 to Intersect, audit, fees, taxes, and a Dev Gov Day 2027 deposit.
Rare Network says it will return 20% of all VIP ticket sales to the Cardano Treasury, with the current VIP ticket retail price stated as $900.

Rare Evo 2026 will occur regardless of treasury funding, but the requested funding is claimed to expand Cardano presence, accessibility, participation, and industry outreach through existing event infrastructure.
Rare Network claims it has been active in the Cardano ecosystem since 2020 and has operated Rare Evo annually for five consecutive years.

The proposal reports Rare Evo 2025 metrics including 2,500 annual attendance, 80 exhibitor booths, 85 speakers, 100+ ecosystem partners, 20K+ livestream views, 4M social media impressions, and 40+ Cardano projects represented.

The proposal states Cardano Dev Gov Day 2025 was free and publicly accessible, welcomed approximately 500 attendees, and included workshops, panels, networking, a Charles Hoskinson keynote, and governance and technical education.
The proposal points to YouTube videos, an X livestream post, and a Google Docs report as supporting materials for Rare Evo 2025 and Cardano Dev Gov Day 2025 activity.

The proposal says selected Cardano projects and contributors will use open application or giveaway processes for speaking opportunities, booth space, volunteer participation, travel and lodging support, hotel rooms, and VIP tickets.

The proposer asserts the sponsorship aligns with governance, community and ecosystem growth, and ecosystem sustainability by increasing education, coordination, onboarding, visibility, and industry engagement.

summary: The proposal seeks ₳2.75M for Rare Network to provide Cardano title sponsorship benefits across Rare Evo 2026 and Cardano Dev Gov Day 2026, with claimed public access, project support, contributor travel support, media and livestream exposure, and a 20% VIP ticket sales return to the treasury.
